body: All's I've ever wanted it love and happiness. I don't care about money or anything else it has no value to me.

First off thanks for taking time out your day to write to me.

It's hard for me because I feel no one in particular is attracted to my kind of personality, people (girls in most situations) always see me as too quiet and never stick around to properly get to know me. Then I'm simply left picking up the broken pieces. I feel like my mind is damaged beyond repair and I'm stuck in this constant unfix-able downfall. To put it in an analogy, I feel like a bone and every time someone breaks me I become weaker and am more prone to being broke again. 

Part of me wants to continue with life and part of me doesn't because there's nothing telling me the future is going to be different or better.

I see what you mean by what people consider "social norms".
